decision: Replace one-pass mixed phase2 training with staged in-memory sequencing: phase1 suffix choice, phase2 phrase suffix warm-up, then phase3 full residual suffix ladder reconnect. Keep decoder CE, runtime, Gemma, harness, checkpoint export, and promotion closed.
